text:
sam.green: Quick sync — scheduling a minimal base image rebake tonight 23:00 PT for staging. Goal: drop surface area, rotate ephemeral creds, and validate KMS signing flow before prod cut. Need RBAC patch, signer audit, and a canary rollback plan (canary=5% traffic).

anya.k: Sounds good. Which KMS keys for staging vs prod? Also confirm whether signer role needs scope reduction.

piotr: staging uses alias/redwood-images-kms-stg; prod is alias/redwood-images-kms-prod. No key swap for prod yet. We will tighten the bake role in staging: remove s3:PutObject and remove wide secrets:Get permissions. Use `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/redwood-images-kms-stg` to check rotation.

sam.green: Security asks that every signed artifact has a CloudTrail entry and we export KMS events to the audit S3 bucket with 1y retention. Also want cosign provenance stored alongside images. @security-bot create a tracking ticket.

security-bot: Created SEC-9001. Saved CloudTrail filter: `eventSource:kms.amazonaws.com AND (eventName:Encrypt OR eventName:Decrypt OR eventName:Sign)`; export to `s3://redwood-audit-staging` with lifecycle 365d. Assigned @anya.k and @piotr.

carla: Build changes: switch to rootless buildkit, remove setuid bits, and run final image as non-root user. Add bake args: `--cap-drop=ALL --cap-add=CHOWN` and ensure `USER 10001` in Dockerfile. Also swap to `alpine:3.18-musl` variant to reduce glibc CVE surface, but note musl differences — run quick compatibility smoke tests.

anya.k: RBAC plan: replace `baking` SA's cluster-edit with a narrow `images:baker` custom ClusterRole — permissions: image push/pull to the repo, kms:Encrypt on the staging key, no secrets.list/read. We should ship the TF change pre-window. Can someone volunteer to PR?

piotr: I'll open PR against infra-iam with the new ClusterRole and a migration job to change rolebinding subjects. Need 2 reviewers from eng-security for merge. I'll link the PR once created.

sam.green: Canary rollback playbook: pause rotation, pin workloads to previous signed digest, revoke canary tokens, and trigger incident channel if errors > 1% for 15m. Who's on-call for the window?

oncall-sre: I'm oncall tonight — will watch canary metrics and can trigger the rollback. Please post the prometheus alerts we'll use.

carla: Note on images: pin the base digest in the staging manifests and keep changelog of removed packages. Also scan for leftover setuid files: `find / -perm /4000 -type f` in the container during CI.

piotr: Short checklist to tick during window:
```
- confirm cosign attestation: `cosign verify --key k8s://k8s-secret/keys/cosign <image>@sha256:<digest>`
- validate CloudTrail KMS entries for Sign/Encrypt after bake
- ensure TF PR merged and `kubectl get clusterrolebinding baker-binding` shows the new role
- bake job ran as non-root and showed `--cap-drop=ALL` in logs
- smoke tests for musl apps passed (env var feature flags toggled)
```

sam.green: Can reviewers sign off by 20:45 PT so we can start the bake at 23:00? :thumbsup:

anya.k: Will review, aiming for 20:30 PT.

security-bot: SEC-9001 updated: reviewers assigned @anya.k @piotr; alert rule snippets, CloudTrail queries, and sample cosign commands attached to ticket.
